query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) = CARDINALITY($2::uuid[]) AS "has_channels!"
            FROM comms_channel_participants
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND channel_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
              AND left_at IS NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM comms_channel_agents ca
                  WHERE ca.channel_id = comms_channel_participants.channel_id
                    AND ca.kind = 'direct'
              )
